purpose: Thin one-command promotion runner for a frozen branch: gatecheck (gate + concentration + robustness) -> forward-protocol verdict (refuse if no new data) -> paper checklist status (reuse existing rehearsal summaries only if the same signals were rehearsed, else MISSING) -> single PROMOTE/HOLD/REJECT with reasons file. Analysis/code ONLY; no backtests, no training, no fitting, no live orders.

reuse.method: importlib import of scripts/opencode_gatecheck.py (as GC) and scripts/opencode_forward_test.py (as FT); all gate / concentration / robustness / forward / paper / decide logic is CALLED, never copied
reuse.wrapper_owns_only: CLI + paper rehearsal auto-lookup by signal match + orchestration + reasons-file assembly

thresholds_mirror.note: MIRRORS ONLY. Authoritative values live in configs/opencode_gatecheck.json and configs/opencode_forward_protocol.json; this block is a pre-specified frozen copy so the promotion run is auditable without re-reading both files. If any value here disagrees with its source, the SOURCE wins and this config must be fixed.

robustness_margins.mirror_of: opencode_forward_protocol.json:robustness_margins (hard margins; gatecheck warns are advisory only)

thresholds_mirror.paper_mirror_of: opencode_forward_protocol.json:paper_ops (all six must be PASS for green)

paper_matching.method: A rehearsal summary is reused for a candidate ONLY if one of its signal-identity fields suffix-matches the candidate --signals path (POSIX suffix, backslash-normalized). Checked fields in order: halt_trip_params.divergence_baseline_signals, config_snapshot.data.signals_replay_only, signal_set_identity.baseline_signals_path. Explicit --paper-summary files are always evaluated but their match/mismatch is recorded; auto-lookup (no --paper-summary) reuses ONLY matches, else paper_paths=[] and paper_source=MISSING.

known_missing.dd_guard_tp075: No rehearsal ever replayed the L3 s0004-pool signals; auto-lookup must yield MISSING (paper NOT_GREEN) until a dedicated rehearsal is run.

decision_rule.PROMOTE: forward_status READY AND forward research-gate PASS on all forward scenarios AND concentration diffuse AND robustness margins PASS AND forward months >= 6 AND degradation ratio >= 0.50 AND paper_overall green (all six). Forward BLOCKED can NEVER promote (caps at HOLD).
decision_rule.REJECT: forward READY with fills-fail in any scenario OR concentration FAIL OR total_net <= 0; or forward BLOCKED with in-sample REJECT-class (same REJECT conditions on the reference window).
decision_rule.HOLD: Everything else (typically monthly-fail and/or dd-breach with fills intact and concentration diffuse, and/or FORWARD_BLOCKED, and/or paper-not-green).
decision_rule.mirror_of: opencode_forward_protocol.json:promotion_rule (which itself mirrors opencode_gatecheck.json:decision_rule plus forward+paper proof)

exit_codes.0: Successful analysis; verdict (PROMOTE/HOLD/REJECT) lives in the payload and stdout, not in the exit code.
exit_codes.2: Tool/input/refusal error (missing file, bad branch, forward on opened dates, overlapping forward trades, --out already exists so no overwrite). No verdict file is written on refusal.

a_majority_1x.expect: HOLD with monthly-fail + dd-breach + FORWARD_BLOCKED reasons, never PROMOTE

b_dd_guard_tp075.expect: HOLD with monthly-fail + FORWARD_BLOCKED + paper MISSING reasons, never PROMOTE

c_synthetic_pass.branch: synthetic green branch per tests/test_forward_test.py run_case(fwd=True)
c_synthetic_pass.expect: PROMOTE possible (forward READY + green paper); proves the machine CAN promote, it is the candidates that fail, not the wiring

warnings: EXPLORATORY until a forward window exists; in-sample verdicts are reference only, never promotion claims.
Drawdown is trade-candle-close sampled, not true mark-price or full intrabar drawdown.
Stop/timeout exits are market-like at the scenario fee, NOT guaranteed maker/limit fills.
Do not claim maker fill probability or queue position from OHLC alone.
Capital is compounded from current equity, initial capital indexed to 100; fixed 1x is the baseline, confidence leverage capped at 2x until validated.
